Relive [[Lieutenant Thackeray|Keiran]] and [[Miku]] tracking down and defeating [[Danthor the Adamant|Danthor]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Locate Danthor the Adamant.
*Defeat Danthor the Adamant.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 1,250 [[Ebon Vanguard rank|Vanguard reputation points]]
* First time: 2 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]]
* On repeat: 5 [[War Supplies]]

== Walkthrough ==
Follow the path along [[Majesty's Rest]] towards the [[Sage Lands]]. There are fewer foes if you go around the north of [[The Mausoleum]] and [[Rotscale]].

As in other [[Hearts of the North]] mini-missions:
* Use [[Keiran's_Sniper_Shot_(Hearts_of_the_North)|Keiran's Sniper Shot]] against targets called out by Miku, which causes over 900 points of damage if it hits (unless Miku's [[Promise of Death]] is removed).
* If Miku dies, she will self-resurrect once no enemies are in earshot.

==Notes==
* This quest is automatically obtained upon entering Majesty's Rest (via the Scrying Pool), and will be removed should one leave.
* The foes that spawn near Danthor (friendly until approached) can be individually pulled.
** Danthor can be separated from his group and killed quickly, ending the mission. Attack him, step back and wait for Miku to call him as a target, then use Keiran's Sniper Shot to finish the job.
** Even if you die, this quest can still be completed if Danthor dies (either via Miku or degen).
* If your inventory is full after Danthor is defeated, any reward items will be dropped on the ground; they will be in the [[Unclaimed Items]] box the next time you enter an [[outpost]], if you do not get a chance to pick them up sooner.
* While you must equip [[Keiran's Bow]] to access this mission, you can switch it out for another weapon, including a long or flatbow for pulling and especially one that has [[weapon upgrade]]s appropriate to Keiran's skills. However, you cannot increase his maximum health, energy, or total attributes using weapon or armor upgrades.
* [[Rotscale]] can be killed during this mission, making this an easy way to get [[Rotwing Recurve Bow]]. However, his death during this mission will not count for his [[Rotscale (Zaishen quest)|Zaishen Bounty]].
